Title: Mocha
Description: A delicious combination of rich espresso, smooth steamed milk, and premium chocolate, creating a perfectly balanced coffee with a sweet and creamy flavor. Topped with a soft layer of milk foam, this indulgent drink is ideal for anyone who enjoys the rich taste of chocolate blended with freshly brewed coffee.
Author: Kaldi

Title: Americano
Description: A classic and refreshing coffee prepared by combining freshly brewed espresso with hot water. It has a smooth, rich, and slightly bold flavor while maintaining the natural aroma of high-quality coffee beans. Simple yet satisfying, Americano is a perfect choice for those who prefer a strong coffee without milk or added sweetness.
Author: Kaldi

Title: Latte
Description: A smooth and creamy coffee made with a rich shot of espresso and plenty of steamed milk, topped with a delicate layer of soft milk foam. Its balanced flavor and velvety texture make it a perfect choice for coffee lovers who enjoy a mild, comforting, and refreshing cup of coffee.
Author: Kaldi
